-- 只读核对木材表项，并在局部环境验证条件；不改全局寄存器、断点或游戏状态。
local context=debug_getCurrentContextTable(false)
assert(type(context)=='table','Stopped context required')
local tableAddress=0x3A484D9F8E8
local goods=0x3A4012E4A60
local storage=readQword(tableAddress+8)
local presence=readQword(tableAddress+0x20)
local present=presence~=nil and (presence & (1 << 10))~=0
local raw=nil
if present and math.type(storage)=='integer' and storage~=0 then raw=readQword(storage+10*8) end
local condition=[=[if RCX ~= 0x3A484D9F8E8 then return false end
assert(math.type(RDX) == 'integer' and RDX ~= 0, 'Invalid goods pointer')
local goodsId = readInteger(RDX + 0x10)
assert(goodsId ~= nil, 'Cannot read goods ID')
return goodsId == 10]=]
local env=setmetatable({RCX=tableAddress,RDX=goods},{__index=_G})
local matching=assert(load(condition,'diagnose_matching','t',env))
local matchedOk,matchedResult=pcall(matching)
local otherEnv=setmetatable({RCX=tableAddress+0x100,RDX=0},{__index=_G})
local rejected=assert(load(condition,'diagnose_other_state','t',otherEnv))
local rejectedOk,rejectedResult=pcall(rejected)
local addresses={}
for _,address in ipairs(debug_getBreakpointList() or {}) do addresses[#addresses+1]=string.format('%X',address) end
return {pid=getOpenedProcessID(),rip=string.format('%X',context.RIP),addresses=addresses,
    goodsId=readInteger(goods+0x10),goodsName=readString(goods+0x18,5,false),goodsFlags40=readBytes(goods+0x40,1),
    capacity1D58=readInteger(0x3A484D9F8B8),capacity1D5C=readInteger(0x3A484D9F8BC),
    tableAddress=string.format('%X',tableAddress),storage=storage and string.format('%X',storage) or '',
    presenceWord=presence and string.format('%X',presence) or '',woodPresent=present,
    woodCapacityRaw=raw~=nil and tostring(raw) or '',woodSignedCapacityUnits=raw~=nil and raw/100000 or 0,
    matchingTest={ok=matchedOk,result=matchedResult},otherStateTest={ok=rejectedOk,result=rejectedResult}}
